about: A second open-cut mine on a hillside: ore rocks a miner breaks with a pickaxe, fencing, timber, work lights and a sign, but no job desk, furnace or buyer (the iron goes on to a smelter). No building stands there, so the slot is hostless: its kit rests on the probed ground of one free plot. Same shape as quarry.json, with the map mark as a `mine` row in the kit. Tooling data: no coordinates and no place names.
